title: Extended LSTM: Adaptive Feature Gating for Toxic Comment Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative error analysis of 500 randomly sampled misclassifications to identify false positives where in-group or dialectal language common in marginalized communities is incorrectly flagged as toxic.

Qualitative error analysis of 500 randomly sampled misclassifications to identify instances where the model fails to understand sociolinguistic context, such as minority group members using reclaimed slurs self-referentially in solidarity contexts.
